candidate_decisions.rationale: Outside the deterministic development prefix; subsidy-process access, installer and supplier adoption, official-system substitution, price, repeat demand, and channel economics remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Selected as the deterministic top development candidate; commissioned-configuration data access, OEM authority, distributor adoption, liability, pricing, and recurring release volume remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Selected in the deterministic development prefix; converter and brand evidence sharing, PPWR timing, incumbent tooling, channel commitment, price, and reusable-data rights remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Outside the deterministic development prefix; eFTI platform certification boundaries, TMS integration, timing, incumbent response, payer urgency, and repeat economics remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Selected in the deterministic development prefix; owner mandates, demolition-material classification and liability, buyer demand, contractor channel access, logistics, and contribution margins remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Outside the deterministic development prefix; guarantee registry access, supplier cooperation, buyer willingness to pay, platform overlap, distribution, and transaction economics remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Selected in the deterministic development prefix; lawful feed classification, food-business and feed-operator rights, steady volume, quality assurance, buyer pricing, and logistics economics remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.

Outside the deterministic development prefix; inspection evidence authority, damage causation, insurer and rental-platform adoption, false claims, pricing, and repeat margins remain adverse but nonfatal uncertainty.
